rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dynamic_Loader {
    meta:
        description = "Detects runtime loading of Cobalt Strike beacons via reflective injection"
        author = "SOC Team"
        malpedia_reference = "https://malpedia.caad.fkie.fraunhofer.de/details/win.cobalt_strike"
        malpedia_version = "20260409"
        malpedia_license = "Creative Commons CC-BY-SA 4.0"
    strings:
        $x64_header = { 4D 5A 90 00 03 00 00 00 04 00 00 00 FF FF } // MZ + minimal PE
        $reflective_loader = "ReflectiveLoader" wide ascii
        $c2_config_marker = { 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 } // Zero-padded config
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and $x64_header at 0 and $reflective_loader and #c2_config_marker > 2
}
